AARTIPHARM.technical: Consolidating within a constructive double bottom base above rising 50-day and 200-day SMAs. Momentum remains supportive with RSI at 66 and positive MACD alignment, showing proper supply absorption beneath the 1048.30 pivot.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Robust CDMO and API demand drove 45.9% revenue expansion and 156% profit growth. EBITDA margins sit strong near 24.8% with conservative leverage (0.32 debt-to-equity), satisfying key CANSLIM institutional criteria.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Failure to hold the 963.18 support level breaches base integrity; cut losses immediately.

ABDL.technical: Forming a 14% deep cup base with a tight 2.5% handle resting above key 50-day and 200-day moving averages. Overhead resistance near 855.55 requires higher volume to confirm genuine institutional demand.
ABDL.fundamental: Steady 15.9% top-line growth backed by premium spirits volume and 18.4% ROCE. However, net earnings growth decelerated to 11.2%, failing CANSLIM's 25% hurdle and capping leadership potential.
ABDL.risk: A drop below the 795.67 handle support invalidates the setup; exit decisively.

ADANIENSOL.technical: Trading tightly within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on expanding 2.33x volume. The price respects rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 moving averages in an exemplary Stage 2 accumulation structure.
ADANIENSOL.fundamental: Massive ₹87,000 crore transmission order book and smart metering expansion drove a 51% surge in revenue and 145% net profit jump. Operating EBITDA grew 68%, confirming top-tier operational acceleration.
ADANIENSOL.risk: A breakdown beneath 1553.47 triggers a false breakout failure; enforce immediate capital protection.

AGARWALEYE.technical: Carving out a double bottom base above all major moving averages. Rebound price action recovered prior downward distribution, though clearing the 572.47 neckline pivot remains vital to validate breakout thrust.
AGARWALEYE.fundamental: Aggressive clinical network expansion with 39 new centers drove 31.3% revenue and 55.8% profit growth. EBITDA margin stood firm at 27.9%, backed by dominant 65% institutional holding.
AGARWALEYE.risk: A close below the 529.94 base trough violates the pattern; trigger an instant stop.

AJAXENGG.technical: Staged a sharp 20-day high breakout fueled by a massive 16x average volume surge. Price structure cleared intermediate congestion cleanly, advancing above rising 21 EMA and 50 SMA lines.
AJAXENGG.fundamental: Enjoys 75.5% SLCM market dominance with zero debt and ₹1,150 crore in cash reserves. ROCE is solid at 23.9%, though sub-10% revenue growth partially trails top-tier CANSLIM velocity benchmarks.
AJAXENGG.risk: A reversal below 579.93 marks a bull trap breakout; sell immediately without hesitation.

ALICON.technical: Constructing a double bottom base along its rising 50-day and 200-day moving averages. Momentum is robust with RSI at 71, though confirming the 1019.02 neckline trigger requires an influx of volume.
ALICON.fundamental: Hybrid vehicle and auto-component contract ramp-ups drove record quarterly revenue of ₹652 crore (+51.8% YoY) and 26.7% profit growth. Balance sheet remains stable, though raw material costs require ongoing monitoring.
ALICON.risk: A retreat below 925.93 violates key base lows and moving averages; exit quickly.
